name: roadmap
description: Private deterministic roadmap and target feasibility summary for one Parle learner

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the owning learner

placement_result_id.description: Source placement_result record, empty when no result is available

plan_key.description: Stable owner-scoped idempotency key for this source version

version.description: Increasing roadmap version for profile changes

track.description: Learning track used by the plan

target_date.description: Local target date as YYYY-MM-DD, empty when there is no deadline

time_zone.description: Learner IANA time zone used for local dates

required_hours.description: Guided hours for the largest weighted gap

available_hours.description: Available hours before the target date

minutes_per_day_needed.description: Extra daily practice needed to keep the requested date, or zero when unavailable

realistic_date.description: Projected date at current availability when a target date is missed

projected_date.description: Projected date when the learner has no deadline

current_levels.description: JSON object with the four starting planning estimates

target_levels.description: JSON object with the four parsed skill targets
